_comment: Model prices, in cost units per 1k tokens, keyed by the exact model id the provider reports (i.e. the value of AI_PROVIDER_MODEL). Prices are supplied by the project owner and must never be invented or guessed. Cost-guard arithmetic: cost = (tokens_in + tokens_out) / 1000 * price. A model with no entry here is UNPRICED: the quota guard then reports the cost as an unresolved operand (visible on the decision) instead of silently treating the model as free. This file lives under config/ on purpose -- scripts/build_cloud_bundle.py copies config/ into the release bundle (CONFIG_EXCLUDES only drops 'production' and 'monitoring'), whereas data/ is gitignored and never ships, so prices placed there would never reach production.
_price_provenance: gpt-5.6-sol = 0.01 :: quoted by the project owner (2026-09-15) as 10 CNY per 1,000,000 tokens, so (10 / 1000000) * 1000 = 0.01 per 1k tokens. The owner said the main account may adjust this later; editing this one number IS the whole mechanism -- no code change, effective on the next process start. qwen2.5:3b is deliberately ABSENT: it runs on the local Ollama instance and has no per-token marginal cost. Writing 0 for it would be a lie that silences the rule (0 is always within budget); leaving it absent keeps the rule 'not applicable' and visible on the decision.
_how_to_verify: cd /d/LiuHao-AI-OS && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'D:/LiuHao-AI-OS');from src.ai.agent_factory import economy_inputs;print(economy_inputs('p','gpt-5.6-sol',1000,500))" -- it must print an estimated_cost key for a priced model, and must NOT print one for an unpriced model.
